## Documentation Issue
Describe what is unclear, outdated, broken, or missing.

## Proposed Improvement
Describe what should be updated or added.

## Relevant Section
File path and section heading (e.g., `README.md` -> Installation and Setup, `docs/API_DOCUMENTATION.md`).

## Expected Result
How a developer or user should understand the topic after the update.
